summary.headline: Crescent Visibility and Almanac Tables
summary.text: Instructions for recording the Moon’s latitude and two distances in an almanac table at sunset on the twenty-ninth day, using them to judge crescent visibility and mark the beginning or end of the month. Introduces an example of the right-page appendices from a 519 Jalālī-year almanac for Khonabaz.
